name: Fairytale Thief: Snow White
source:
You are Ethel White (name changeable), a vampire.

There's an estate in the town that houses a famous old mirror which reflects nothing.

You need that mirror.

You asked nicely, and seven people offered their help.

You still have time before the big day.

Who are you spending that time with?

[From [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/fairytale-thief-snow-white]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是埃塞尔·怀特（Ethel White）（名字可更改），一个吸血鬼。

镇上有一处庄园，里面有一面著名的老镜子，镜子什么也反射不了。

你需要那面镜子。

你问得好，有七个人提供了帮助。

在重要的日子到来之前你还有时间。

你和谁一起度过这段时间？

[来自[url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/fairytale-thief-snow-white]itch.io[/url]]
